name: button
title: Button
description: The action control: five weights and a brand fill, a buy/sell tone, sm/md/lg and a 44 px touch size, icon-only, a loading state that keeps its size and focus, and a label that changes in place.
whenToUse: Any action that happens on click: submit, save, open, run. One primary (or accent) per view.
notFor: Navigation to another page (a link; or asChild around the link when it must look like a button).
A destructive action that needs friction (confirm-morph or hold-to-confirm).

anatomy: root (button, or the child element with asChild)
leading icon (any icon element among the children, before the text)
label (the text; its width follows the text when it changes)
loader (a spinner that opens in front of the label while loading)

size: touch (44 px, bottom action bars on phones)
shape: icon-only (square; detected when there is no text)

states: pressed (scale 0.97, icon/sm 0.95, at 0ms; none on popup anchors or with reduced motion)
focus (the look's focus ring, never animated)
working (loading: loader opens in front of the label, size and focus kept, aria-busy, clicks ignored)
resolved (the caller changes the label in place, e.g. Save → Saved; never reverted by a timer)
error (the caller keeps or restores the label and shows the message next to the cause; the button never turns red)
keyboard: Tab focuses; focus stays on the button through loading
spec.motion: Hover colour arrives at 0ms and leaves over --pui-motion-out. Press scales to 0.97 at once (narrow buttons 0.95) and springs back. A changed label slides up out of a soft blur while the width follows on spring.morph; the loader opens its width from 0 so nothing jumps. Reduced motion: colour changes only, no scale, no slide.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. primary is the ink-filled main action; accent fills with the brand; danger is for destructive actions.

props.name: size
props.description: Height 32 / 36 / 40 px; touch 44 px for a bottom action bar on a phone.

props.name: tone
props.description: Market side. On primary/accent the fill becomes --pui-up (buy) or --pui-down (sell) with the matching on-colour ink; on quiet variants the label takes the colour. Pair with a word or arrow.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the loader, sets aria-busy and ignores clicks; size and focus stay.

props.name: look
props.description: Paint this button in another look than the one in force around it. Primary and accent are solids, secondary a raised control; outline, ghost and danger keep their own quiet paint.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the single child (a link, a Radix trigger) with the button's look and behaviour.

props.name: ...button attributes
props.description: type defaults to "button". Icon-only buttons need aria-label.

spec.appearance: Managed appearance changes preserve mounted controls and operational state. Instance design props override scoped defaults; classNames addresses documented slots. Managed appearance updates preserve mounted controls and operational state. Motion reads individual CSS duration, easing, spring and stagger tokens at the actual host; no first-document-root lookup. Reduced/none policy wins over speed; semantic reading intervals and data pacing do not scale. Motion reads the actual host: semantic chart glide (500ms), chart sweep (600ms), insight page (240ms) or press-scale as applicable; durations scale with the scope, reduced/none wins. Appearance does not reset values or a finished entrance.

review.notes: Rewritten from spec; asChild replaces the old class adapter.
